summary: Successor note to environment/sc2-reserved-storage-delivered (#4746), which describes the binding into the former fsharp-dev container and lists rebind/persistence as gap (2). Since 2026-10-30 the 256 GiB backing.img of operation e995b57ee030f4b8b9d2f61df5ab4a76 is attached to the fdev VM as virtio disk `fdev-sc2` (no copy; file stays on Home's HDD, root-owned, Home VMM user granted an rw ACL), mounted by systemd at /srv/sc2-reserved and bind-mounted at the original guest path /var/tmp/fsgg-sc2-reserved/e995b57ee030f4b8b9d2f61df5ab4a76 (parent 0711). Both mounts come from fdev's image and survive fdev restarts and upgrades (verified after a cold restart on 2026-10-30). The store owner changed from the container mapping 101000 to fdev's developer 1000 (only objects owned by 101000 were re-owned); capacity limits unchanged (255 GiB filesystem, 44 KiB used at migration). The Home sudoers uninstall rule was retired; disposition now happens inside fdev. Trust: fdev's developer has root inside the VM, so protection inside fdev is cooperative; the boundary is the VM. The binder/helper design for container mount namespaces no longer applies. Not verified: SC2 client workload use.
title: SC2 reserved storage op e995b57e now lives in fdev as an attached disk; rebind/persistence gap closed by fdev mounts
